text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a veritable maelstrom of fervor and

excitement, the curtain falls on the
Twinkle Star
Climax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the spectators are celebrating the
emergence
of the greatest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
I'm sorry
we didn't get the chance to
speak properly for a
while!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I was completely swamped with my
duties... But
things have settled down for
the moment, so I
thought I'd come and
see you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for all your hard
work!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh, think nothing of it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Without your cooperation, Trainer

<username>, the
race series
would never have flourished
like it did!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Your partner's efforts, your granting me
the
opportunity to write that report, and
your
participation in the races
themselves...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Star Climax simply wouldn't
have
been possible without all your
contributions.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I just want you to know how much I
appreciate
everything!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The reality has finally sunk in... The
greatest
Umamusume has been crowned.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It's really happened...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so. It's a strange feeling to finally

accomplish what you've always dreamed
of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, Reporter Otonashi looks
out over
the now-empty track with a
vaguely melancholy
expression on her
face.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, Mom! Wasn't that race amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: It really was! They were all very cool.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the greatest Umamusume
someday
too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right... It will go on for as
long as
there are Umamusume who strive
for greatness!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! The Climax was such a
grand
success that I'd better start
planning for the next
one!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I am! I'll keep striving onward as a reporter so by the time that young Umamusume is old enough to compete, the Climax will be even better!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now, as my first step on the road to the
second
Climax, it's time to interview a
distinguished
contributor! How are you
feeling right now?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Climax might be over, but the
dream I share
with
<chrname> lives on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once again, we make a firm vow to fully
support
each other as we continue down
this path!
